sources.text: Totally get that—nothing beats a real test. I’m rooting for it to work out, especially if it means I can stop begging my neighbor to water my thyme. Let me know how it goes Sunday evening, yeah? I’m curious about the before-and-after soil feel.
"I'll definitely let you know how the testing goes when I get my results on Sunday evening—I'll keep you posted!"

Sounds good—no pressure, but I’m genuinely curious how it turns out. If the soil stays just right, you might be onto something bigger than thyme. Anyway, gotta run—my community dinner group just texted; turns out half the crew is coming an hour late. One folding table, as usual. Chaos incoming.

"No problem at all! I'm glad to hear the data is shaping up well. I’ll be sure to send over a full report on Sunday evening! Take care with your dinner—hope the late arrivals make it to the table okay!"
Appreciate that—looking forward to your full report. And hey, late arrivals are half the fun. More time to burn the garlic bread while we wait. See you Sunday!
"Sounds like a fun evening! Enjoy your dinner and have a great time—I'll make sure to send over that full report on Sunday evening!"
